decision: Retain the reproducible BMW off-mode gain: all six pairs faster, audit frame-time changes -9.4805%/-9.0637%. Accept and explicitly report the BMW 4x cost: all six pairs slower, +1.6397%/+0.8907%. BMW 2x is mixed (+0.5194%/-1.3290%, 3/6 faster), so no 2x improvement is claimed. T-80 is mixed, including 2x +0.2651%/+0.9393% with 4/6 pairs slower. The strong off-mode BMW gain justifies this trade-off under the current open-research objective; next investigate MSAA dispatch/code layout without changing sample arithmetic. No causal native-code/cache claim is established.
